## [1.0.4](https://github.com/raphaelbahat/zotero-self-hosted-sync/compare/v1.0.3...v1.0.4) (2026-09-24)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **ci:** retire dev — release on main, and validate dependabot against it ([198e670](https://github.com/raphaelbahat/zotero-self-hosted-sync/commit/198e670d8f861b0a6cb9a955fc1a78aa0bd1a553))

patches.name: Custom sync server
patches.description: Redirects Zotero's sync API and live-update stream to your own server.

options.description: HTTPS origin of your self-hosted Zotero server, for example https://zotero.example.org. Only the host (with an optional port) is accepted: no path and no trailing slash. A missing scheme is assumed to be https://.

Full WebSocket URL for live updates, for example wss://zotero.example.org/stream or ws://zotero.example.org/stream. A path is allowed. Leave empty to derive it from the server address as wss://<server>/stream.

patches.name: Custom sync server: allow cleartext streaming
patches.description: Adds the chosen streaming host to the app's cleartext allow-list when the stream URL is ws:// or http://.

options.description: HTTPS origin of your self-hosted Zotero server, for example https://zotero.example.org. Only the host (with an optional port) is accepted: no path and no trailing slash. A missing scheme is assumed to be https://.

Full WebSocket URL for live updates, for example wss://zotero.example.org/stream or ws://zotero.example.org/stream. A path is allowed. Leave empty to derive it from the server address as wss://<server>/stream.

patches.name: Enable verbose logging
patches.description: For development only. Plants Timber's debug tree so the app's own log lines reach logcat — expect a lot of output, and do not patch this into a build you rely on.

patches.name: Recover attachments with an unusable modification time
patches.description: Temporary workaround: the Zotero Android app discards an attachment whose stored modification time it cannot parse, instead of repairing it, so the file is never uploaded. Reported upstream: https://github.com/zotero/zotero-android/issues/351
